tools.process_get_state: Return full Process Expert state: nodes, edges, isRunning, activePreset.
tools.process_get_metrics: Return per-node simulation metrics: id, label, type, state.
tools.process_start: Start the simulation in Process Expert.
tools.process_stop: Stop (pause) the simulation in Process Expert.
tools.process_reset: Reset the simulation in Process Expert.
tools.process_list_presets: Return available built-in preset names for Process Expert.
tools.process_load_preset: Load a named preset in Process Expert. Call process_list_presets first.
tools.process_get_library: Return the user's saved diagram library from localStorage.
tools.process_save_library: Save the current diagram to the user library under the given name.
tools.process_set_nodes: Replace all nodes in the Process Expert canvas.
tools.process_set_edges: Replace all edges in the Process Expert canvas.
tools.process_run_headless: Run Process Expert headlessly for N ticks without disturbing the live view. Returns per-node final states. 60 ticks ≈ 1 second.
tools.process_get_history: Return the tick-by-tick simulation history logs for plotting.
tools.process_run_monte_carlo: Run a Monte Carlo simulation headlessly on the current Process Expert canvas. Aggregates numeric variables across runs and returns mean (avg) and standard deviation (stdDev). Runs default to 100 and ticks to 3600.
tools.process_run_optimizer:
Run a parameter sweep optimizer headlessly on the current Process Expert canvas. Sweeps the parameter space and returns the best and top 5 parameter configurations.

targetMetric: format 'nodeId.key' (e.g. 'wf_ops.value')
params: list of dicts: [{'nodeId': '...', 'key': '...', 'min': 0, 'max': 15, 'step': 1}]
mode: 'maximize' or 'minimize'
strategy: 'grid_sweep' or 'genetic'
populationSize: genetic algorithm population size (default: 12)
generations: genetic algorithm generations (default: 6)
mutationRate: genetic algorithm mutation rate (default: 0.25)
tools.process_get_schema: Return the Process Expert schema describing NodeTypes, ProcessNodeData fields, ProcessEdgeData fields, and Custom Code API context features.

stock.description: Continuous accumulator in System Dynamics (SD) modeling. Stores a numeric quantity that changes smoothly over ticks based on connected inflow/outflow edge flow rates.

stateFields._initialValue: number — reset value when simulation restarts

stock.routing: Flow equations are specified on outgoing/incoming edges via data.equation (e.g., 'stockA * 0.05' or constants).

cloud.description: Infinite source or sink boundaries for continuous System Dynamics flows. Used to represent entry or exit limits outside the modeled system.

stateFields.value: number — always Infinity (for sources) or accumulated discard values (for sinks)

source_simple.description: Discrete-event generator that periodically spawns new Entity items and pushes them downstream.

stateFields.entityType: string — type field for spawned entities (e.g. 'customer', 'item')
stateFields.spawnRate: number — tick interval between spawns (used for 'fixed' distribution)
stateFields.spawnMean: number — mean rate for exponential distribution
stateFields.spawnStdDev: number — standard deviation for normal timing
stateFields.spawnLambda: number — rate parameter for poisson arrivals
stateFields.payloadDistributions: array — list of random variables sampled and merged into the spawned entity's payload (e.g. [{'key': 'severity', 'type': 'uniform', 'min': 1, 'max': 5}])

machine.description: Processes discrete entities pulled from its queue one at a time. Simulates delay/capacity constraints.

stateFields.queue: Entity[] — FIFO array of waiting items
stateFields.capacity: number — maximum queue length (entities entering a full queue are dropped)
stateFields.processing: Entity | null — entity currently in service
stateFields.processingTime: number — default service time (ticks) for 'fixed' distribution
stateFields.processingTimeLeft: number — ticks remaining before current entity completes
stateFields.processingTimeMean: number — mean service time for exponential

custom.description: Executes custom JavaScript/TypeScript code in data.code at every tick. Used for custom queuing, delays, triggers, or routing.

stateFields.anyCustomKey: any — user scripts can define and read arbitrary state properties directly on the state object

custom.apiDetails: Uses customCodeAPI (push, spawn, chance, rateLimit, processNext, randomDistributions). Custom code runs inside a secure sandbox.

userInput.description: Implements an alert gate or approval prompt. Halts entities in its queue until approved/rejected (via buttons in the UI, Autopilot rules, or custom scripts). Also used to seize or release resources.

stateFields.queue: Entity[] — waiting list of alerts or entities
stateFields.seizeResource: string — optional ID of a 'resource' node to seize before pushing approved entities
stateFields.releaseResource: string — optional ID of a 'resource' node to release after resolving entities
stateFields.ruleCode: string — rule/policy code evaluated by Autopilot to make decisions automatically (e.g., 'if (resourcePool.count > 0) approve()')

userInput.routing: If data.code (custom JS) is defined, the engine bypasses automatic forwarding and delegates all routing to the custom script.

resource.description: Maintains a pool of reusable resources (like workers, trucks, or servers) that can be seized/released by userInput gates or custom nodes.

stateFields.count: number — number of currently idle/available resource units
stateFields.total: number — total resource capacity of the pool

gridNode.description: Hosts a 2D grid cell Cellular Automaton (CA) simulation (e.g. fire spreading, geographic heatmaps). Cells transition concurrently.

stateFields.gridMask: boolean[][] — optional geographic land mask (cells marked false are treated as water/oceans and ignored)
stateFields.burningCoords: array — list of active coordination points (used by suppressing nodes to track active cells)

gridNode.codeDetails: Transition rules are specified in data.code (evaluates next cell state based on neighborhood values).

router.description: Routes incoming entities to target outputs by evaluating custom JS logic in data.code.

stateFields.queue: Entity[] — inputs are queued briefly before routing evaluations

router.behavior: Custom code must evaluate to target edge label string (e.g. 'high_priority') or call push().

sink.description: Consumes completed discrete entities and maintains operational diagnostics (throughput, wait times).

stateFields._totalWaitTime: number — accumulated queue wait ticks across all consumed entities
stateFields.avgWaitTime: string — auto-calculated wait time label (e.g. '12.4 ticks')

sink.apiDetails: Uses the consume() helper to automatically track wait duration (tickCount - entity.payload._spawnTick) and update averages in the UI.

data.label: string — display label
data.type: string — NodeType duplicate matching parent type
data.code: string — custom JavaScript/TypeScript logic (used by 'custom', 'router', 'gridNode' cells)
data.state: NodeState — node state object (numeric fields, queue, processing, processingTimeLeft)
data.outputs: string[] — list of output handle/edge names

grid.size: number — cell display size in pixels

data.travelTime: number — duration in ticks for entities to travel across the edge
data.rateLimit: number — maximum entities allowed on edge per tick
data.equation: string — system dynamics flow equation (for flows between stock nodes)
data.travelTimeDistribution: string — statistical distribution for travel time ('fixed' | 'exponential' | 'normal' | 'uniform' | 'triangular' | 'poisson' | 'weibull')
data.travelTimeStdDev: number — standard deviation for normal distribution
data.travelTimeMin: number — minimum travel time for uniform/triangular
data.travelTimeMax: number — maximum travel time for uniform/triangular
data.travelTimeMode: number — mode travel time for triangular

customCodeAPI.inputs: Entity[] — list of incoming Entity objects (each has id, type, payload)
customCodeAPI.push: function(targetHandle: string, entity: Entity) — send entity to target edge handle
customCodeAPI.spawn: function(type: string, payload?: any) — spawn a new entity at this node
customCodeAPI.chance: function(percent: number) -> boolean — return true based on probability percentage
customCodeAPI.rateLimit: function(n: number) -> boolean — return true if rate limit of N entities/tick is not exceeded
customCodeAPI.processNext: function(ticks: number, callback: (item: Entity) => void) — process entity with custom delay callback
customCodeAPI.spawnAtRate: function(rate: number, type: string, payload?: any, handle?: string) — spawn a new entity every N ticks
customCodeAPI.spawnExponential: function(mean: number, type: string, payload?: any, handle?: string) — spawn entity following exponential timing (Poisson arrivals)
customCodeAPI.delay: function(ticks: number, handle?: string) — pull entity, delay by N ticks, and push downstream
customCodeAPI.delayAndTransform: function(ticks: number, newType: string, handle?: string) — pull, delay by N ticks, mutate its type string, and push
customCodeAPI.consume: function(callback: (item: Entity) => void) — pull entity, run callback, and auto-aggregate wait time statistics
customCodeAPI.routeByChance: function(percent: number, trueHandle: string, falseHandle: string) — pull and route entity to true or false handle based on percentage chance
customCodeAPI.callLLM: function(prompt: string, callback: (resultText: string) => void) — invoke Gemini LLM asynchronously and return response to callback
customCodeAPI.seize: function(resourceName: string, amount?: number) -> boolean — attempt to allocate resources from pool, return true on success
customCodeAPI.release: function(resourceName: string, amount?: number) -> boolean — release resources back to pool
customCodeAPI.sortByPriority: function(field?: string, ascending?: boolean) — sort node queue by a payload priority field
customCodeAPI.getShortestQueueNode: function(nodeLabels: string[]) -> string — return node label representing the shortest active queue
customCodeAPI.randomNormal: function(mean: number, stdDev: number) -> number — sample from normal distribution
customCodeAPI.randomExponential: function(rate: number) -> number — sample from exponential distribution
customCodeAPI.randomUniform: function(min: number, max: number) -> number — sample from uniform distribution
customCodeAPI.randomChoice: function(arr: any[]) -> any — pick a random element from an array
customCodeAPI.randomTriangular: function(min: number, mode: number, max: number) -> number — sample from triangular distribution
customCodeAPI.randomPoisson: function(lambda: number) -> number — sample from poisson distribution
customCodeAPI.randomWeibull: function(shape: number, scale: number) -> number — sample from weibull distribution
